component.name: Apache OpenOffice
component.description: Office productivity suite. The published security page ('Security Reports') is a vulnerability reporting policy: undisclosed vulnerabilities go to the private list security@openoffice.apache.org (all other mail to that address is ignored), regular bugs go to the bug reporting page, configuration/applicability/patch questions go to the project's main mailing list, individual security-team OpenPGP keys are available for encrypted reports (with possibly slower response), and vulnerability bulletins and mitigation details are archived in the Apache OpenOffice Security Bulletins archive, including legacy OpenOffice.org releases before 3.4.0. The page documents no threats, assets, or trust boundaries.
